name: Sweet Bonanza Super Scatter

features.name: Pay anywhere
features.description: Eight or more matching candies anywhere on the 6×5 grid pay, with tumbles after each win.

features.name: Super Scatters
features.description: Super Scatters in the trigger pay 100x, 500x, 5,000x or 50,000x depending on how many land.

features.name: Sticky bomb multipliers
features.description: In free spins, multipliers up to 100x stay on the grid until the feature ends.

review:
The familiar 6x5 candy grid: eight or more matching symbols anywhere pay up to 50x, and four to six scatters pay 3x–100x and trigger 10 free spins.

The new bit is the Super Scatter: one in the trigger pays 100x instantly, two pay 500x, three 5,000x and four the 50,000x max. In free spins, bombs up to 100x stay on the grid until the end and add together after each tumble. 96.51% RTP. For fans chasing a bigger top prize.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
